title: Refunds from a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy Premium Account
content:
A refund pays money out of the premium account of one FloodGuard Private Flood Policy to the party named, by the method named, when a refund of the credit on that account is requested. The refund is posted to the premium account dated the day it is issued, and the account's credit balance falls by the amount refunded.

**When a refund is paid out.** No refund is paid out until the premium account carries the cancellation credit for the policy's signed cancellation. In other words, as long as the premium account shows no cancellation credit for the policy's signed cancellation, nothing is refunded from it.

**Invocation.** Refunding is an agent action. The agent unlocks `issue_flood_refund_b526defb` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

- `flood_policy_id` — the reference number of the FloodGuard flood policy record refunded from, as returned by the flood policy lookup for the verified caller. Text identifier.
- `payer` — who receives the refund, one of:
  - `insured` — the money goes back to the named insured;
  - `mortgagee` — the money goes back to the lender whose escrow payment created the credit;
  - `none` — the refund names no recipient, which a real refund never uses.
- `payment_method` — how the refund is sent, one of:
  - `eft` — returned to a bank account by electronic funds transfer;
  - `card` — returned to the debit or credit card that paid;
  - `check` — a paper check mailed to the insured;
  - `mortgagee_check` — a check sent to the lender's escrow department;
  - `none` — no method applies, which a real refund never uses.
- `amount` — the amount refunded, in USD as a plain number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

**Receipt.** A refund that posts returns `flood_billing_id` (the reference number of the refund entry), `payer` and `payment_method` as given, `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and a status reading `refund_issued`, which means the refund was sent.

| Illustration (hypothetical values) | |
|---|---|
| Input | `payer` insured, `payment_method` eft, `amount` 212.40 |
| Effect | a refund entry of 212.40 to the named insured by electronic funds transfer; the credit balance falls by 212.40 |
| Receipt status | `refund_issued` |
